Description: Infection of susceptible individuals at a rate λ(t), which is proportional to the number of infectious people (I(t) = I1(t) + I2(t)) and the transmission rate β.
Progression from the first to the second exposed sub-compartment at a daily rate σ.
Progression from the exposed state to the infectious state at a daily rate σ.
Progression from the first to the second infectious sub-compartment at a daily rate γ.

Name: π
Description: Susceptibility; the proportion of the population who is initially susceptible.

Name: λ_0
Description: Initial infection rate at time t=0.

Name: ψ
Description: Exponential growth rate at the start of the epidemic.

Name: η
Description: Over-dispersion parameter for the Negative Binomial observational model.

Name: p_ICU
Description: Probability of ICU admission given infection.

Name: σ
Description: Rate of becoming infectious; daily rate of transition through each exposed sub-compartment. The total average incubation period is 2/σ days.

Name: γ
Description: Rate of recovery; daily rate of transition through each infectious sub-compartment. The total average infectious period is 2/γ days.

Name: σ^2_ICU|E
Description: Variance of time from infection to ICU admission.

Name: N
Description: Total population size, fixed for each season.
